text_block_list.text:
After her day off, Уиннинг Тикит storms
into my
office with immense fervor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Right? I know! Yesterday I ate lots and
slept even
more!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So now I'm totally powered up—FULL
BLAST!
Like, I'm in super-duper top
condition!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Come on, time to start already! I can do
a million
laps! Let's gooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ticket is brimming with power and spirit
after
thoroughly enjoying her day off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
